about.title: About
about.bio: A technically gifted midfielder who reads the game two steps ahead, Dmytro has built a reputation for his precise passing and relentless pressing that disrupts the opposition before they can settle. Raised through the Dynamo Kyiv youth academy, he combines tactical discipline with the ability to unlock compact defensive shapes. At eighteen he is already the heartbeat of his team — the player who touches the ball most and loses it least.

club.title: Club
club.name: Dynamo Kyiv U21
club.description: One of Ukraine's most decorated clubs, Dynamo Kyiv has produced generations of international footballers. The U21 structure trains alongside the first team, immersing young players in professional standards from day one.

team.title: Team
team.name: Ukraine U18 National Team
team.description: Representing the national team colours at youth level, Dmytro carries his club form into international competition across UEFA development tournaments.
